== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Latari Forest is a large woodland area located near the village of [[Myria]] and the road leading to [[Enosh]]. The forest is known for its dense canopy, cool and wet winds, and various rumors, including tales of a demon that attacks innocent people and reports of [[Bandits|bandits]] operating within its borders. The southeastern corner of the forest is home to [[Orgrith Cave]], which corrupts the surrounding environment, causing trees to shrivel and the ground to turn into sand and blackened grass. In some areas, the landscape features massive, [[stone]]-like rock spikes that resemble stripped tree trunks. A significant feature of the forest is its center, which contains a powerful force that was historically sealed by the [[Damascans]]. To maintain this seal, nine lives were sacrificed annually. This central location is associated with the [[Hanging Tree]], a powerful entity that has been linked to various [[Incarnations]] and historical conflicts. The forest is considered dangerous, and its proximity to [[Myria]] has caused many villagers to avoid the area following traumatic events. The forest also serves as a location that some individuals use for sanity or travel via [[Gates]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Situated near the road to [[Enosh]], the Latari Forest lies in close proximity to the village of [[Myria]]. It is a place where [[Indirial]] once witnessed an illusion of [[Nerissa]]. At the forest's center, a clearing contains the [[Hanging Tree]] and the grave of the [[Valinhall Incarnation]]. [[Kai]] has also been present within this central clearing.}}
